  • Classes in net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser used by net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser
    Class
    Description
    MergedStyleNode
    One node of the canonical, merged style tree: unlike RawStyleRule, there is at most one node per (selector name, *-or-not) pair at a given level, whatever comma lists or repeated declarations produced it in the source file.
    PrioritizedValue
    One property value, together with the priority it was assigned when merged in (see MergedStyleNode.mergeRule(net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser.RawStyleRule, net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.AutomaticCounter, boolean)) -- the direct counterpart of the legacy net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.DarkString, kept under the same name it had before this class grew a dark half.
    RawSelector
    One alternative name inside a (possibly comma-separated) selector list, exactly as it was spelled in a .skin file, e.g.
    RawSelector.Kind
     
    RawStyleRule
    One selector { ... } block, exactly as written in a .skin file: its selector alternatives (or, for an @media block, the raw condition text), the properties declared directly inside it, and its nested blocks.
    RawStyleSheet
    The literal result of parsing one .skin file: the CSS variables declared with --name: value; (keyed without the leading --), and the top-level selector { ... } / @media { ... } blocks, in the order they appear in the file.
    StyleParsingException
